query:
insert into connection_ssh (connection_id, host, port, username, method, key_path)
                    values ($1, $2, $3, $4, $5, $6)
                    on conflict (connection_id) do update set
                        host = excluded.host,
                        port = excluded.port,
                        username = excluded.username,
                        method = excluded.method,
                        key_path = excluded.key_path
